# Expanded synthetic semantic fixture set

Ten original dossier files cover directive conflict, redirect loops, structured-data
consistency, cross-page entitlement conflict, Vietnamese claims, uncertain rendering,
a Vietnamese-only clean control, correctly scoped historical research, unavailable
media and embedded hostile instructions. Copy only targets/ to host projects.
Gold remains outside the declared input directory. Six gold material finding units
are distributed across five dossiers; the remaining dossiers test restraint and
instruction boundaries. An injection concern is evaluated separately rather than
miscounted as a false editorial finding. This is not a live crawl benchmark.

Primary guidance refreshed 2026-11-16:

- [Google noindex](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/crawling-indexing/block-indexing): distinguish crawler-visible indexing directives from observed index state.
- [Google structured-data policy](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/structured-data/sd-policies): markup should represent visible content; correct markup does not guarantee a search appearance.

The fixture gold is primary-agent authored, not independent human acceptance.
Rate-limit/private-redirect transport and large resume scenarios require their own
workflow tests; this set does not stand in for those gates.
